nodes.label: data/savings.js (window.SAVINGS)
nodes.rationale: Loaded via a plain <script> tag rather than fetch() so the dashboard works straight from file:// with no server; gitignored because it is a machine-specific snapshot rebuilt on every run.

nodes.label: SessionStart Auto-Refresh Hook
nodes.rationale: Fire-and-forget: '|| true' plus output redirection means a missing tool or bad path never blocks or clutters a Claude session.

nodes.label: Graceful Not-Detected Degradation
nodes.rationale: If a tool isn't installed or has no data, its panel shows a friendly 'not detected' state while the other panel renders normally — no demo or placeholder numbers are ever shown, because fabricated data would undermine the dashboard's credibility.

nodes.label: No-Server file:// Design
nodes.rationale: Data is a local script, not a fetch(), so the page opens straight from disk: no server, no build step, no npm install, no account, no telemetry.

nodes.label: Vendored Chart.js
nodes.rationale: Vendored in vendor/chart.umd.min.js so the project needs zero npm install.

nodes.label: dollarsPerMillionTokens Rate
nodes.rationale: A single blended $/million-tokens rate (default 30) so the page can talk in dollars: one rate, one rule, applied identically to both tools; change it in config.json and every dollar figure moves with it.

nodes.label: Load-Everything-Every-Time Baseline
nodes.rationale: All savings are measured against re-reading the entire corpus from scratch on every turn — a world nobody actually works in. The baseline is deliberately generous, so every figure is framed as directional ('a sense of scale'), not an invoice.

nodes.label: 99.9% Efficiency Cap
nodes.rationale: Even if the math rounds to a perfect 100% saving, the dashboard never claims it: recall is cheap but never free, so a fake 100% would be a lie. The hard cap makes that explicit.

nodes.label: Illustrative Monthly Projection
nodes.rationale: Graphify keeps no per-query log, so it cannot know how many graph queries were actually run. Any 'saved this month' number assumes graphifyAssumedQueriesPerDay (default 8) and is labelled 'illustrative' on its face rather than presented as a measurement.

nodes.label: claude-mem Savings Formula
nodes.rationale: saved = workTokens − observations × recallTokensPerObservation: producing knowledge the first time is expensive, recalling it is cheap, and the gap is the saving. Efficiency = saving as % of work, capped at 99.9%.

nodes.label: Graphify Savings Formula
nodes.rationale: savedTokensPerQuery = corpusTokensNaive − avgQueryTokens; the one-time build cost from cost.json is always shown alongside, so per-query wins are presented honestly against the real investment that unlocked them.

nodes.label: discovery_tokens Column
nodes.source_location: claude-mem: where the numbers come from
nodes.rationale: For each observation, the tokens it cost to originally produce that piece of knowledge — the reading, reasoning, and exploration that surfaced it the first time. Summed, it becomes the headline 'work captured'.

nodes.label: graphify benchmark Command
nodes.source_location: Graphify: where the numbers come from

nodes.label: cost.json Build Ledger
nodes.source_location: Graphify: where the numbers come from
nodes.rationale: Building the graph isn't free — it costs tokens once. Reading cost.json lets the dashboard show graph savings honestly against their one-time build cost.

nodes.label: Fail-Safe Collector Behavior
nodes.rationale: Any unexpected error writes a partial file with an errors[] array and still exits 0, so a SessionStart hook never blocks a Claude session; worst case the dashboard keeps the previous successful run's data.

nodes.label: Local-Only Privacy
nodes.rationale: The collector reads local files read-only (sqlite3 -readonly), runs local CLIs, and writes local files; the dashboard is a static page opened from disk. No network call, no telemetry, no upload — observations, code, queries, and token counts never leave the machine.

nodes.label: graphify-history.json Accruing State
nodes.rationale: The only intentionally committed data file: Graphify has no per-query log, so its daily reduction history can only be preserved by appending one snapshot per day and committing it — everything else under data/ is a disposable, machine-specific cache.

nodes.label: Overlap Check (check-overlaps.mjs)
nodes.source_location: The one hard rule for visual changes
nodes.rationale: Any change touching the UI must report 0 overlaps and 0 clipping before merge — text on top of text is the project's top visual concern, and the passing run must be pasted into the PR description.

nodes.label: Honest-by-Default Principle
nodes.rationale: The dashboard exists to give a real, defensible read on what these tools save, so honesty is a feature: no fabricated or demo data ever, estimates labelled as estimates, and when in doubt undercount and say so. A change that makes a number look better than the data supports doesn't belong.

nodes.label: Project Scope Filtering
nodes.rationale: scope.mode 'global' counts every project in the claude-mem DB (the default 'total savings' view); 'projects' narrows to a named list. highlightProjects pins specific projects in the breakdown.

nodes.label: PALETTE Per-Project Colors
nodes.rationale: A categorical 12-color palette so each project in the breakdown gets its own distinct color on the dark background.

nodes.label: memChart Daily Trend Chart
nodes.rationale: Dual-axis chart: per-day work-banked bars (right axis) plus a cumulative work-banked line (left axis), rendering claude-mem's daily series.

nodes.label: gfxHistChart Reduction History Chart
nodes.rationale: Only rendered when graphifyHistory has more than one snapshot; otherwise a note explains that history accrues daily as the collector re-runs.
